title: Analysis code: Identification of a human Anxa1-associated dopaminergic population linked to Parkinson’s disease vulnerability and sensorimotor putaminal networks
description:
Analysis and figure code for the manuscript "Identification of a human Anxa1-associated dopaminergic population linked to Parkinson’s disease vulnerability and sensorimotor putaminal networks". The repository contains the hierarchical mixture-of-experts classifier and its released model, the human transfer, disease-vulnerability, projection, and PPMI DaTscan analyses, the DopaBase Human atlas build, and the FDA Drug Target Atlas analysis core with tests.

Derived input tables are distributed separately. Raw and controlled-access source data, including participant-level PPMI data, are not redistributed.
